_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Ansoff product-market growth strategy framing for organizations, products, programs, and initiatives: define the…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Use the Ansoff Matrix to compare growth options for this product."
cases.context: The agent has access to the ansoff-matrix skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is ansoff-matrix the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes ansoff-matrix as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against swot-tows, pestel, porters-five-forces
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the ansoff-matrix workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore ansoff-matrix
Does not route to swot-tows, pestel, porters-five-forces when the ansoff-matrix scope is the owner
